vedic_reference.note: Prathamik strētsuk is a Sanskrit term that signifies the primary or fundamental existence or universe. It is a combination of two roots - pratham (first, primary) and īk (existence, universe). This term is not directly mentioned in the Vedas but is an essential concept in Indian philosophy and spirituality.
